input_messages.content: Hi, um, I need to return a luggage set I bought, but I want to get the same one in red instead. Also, I have a skateboard I want to return and get a new one with specific features—like a 34-inch length and a custom design. Oh, and I also want to return some hiking boots. I'm not sure if all this is possible, but I thought I'd ask.
Okay, thanks. My name is Liam Thomas, and my zip code is 85049. I don't really remember my email right now.

Oh, okay. I guess I understand about the pending order. I really want the bamboo deck for the skateboard, please. And I want to change the luggage set to the red one. I don't want to change the portable charger, so please leave it as is.

But, um, I was hoping to use my credit card for the price difference instead of PayPal or the Visa ending in 3194. Is there any way to do that? 

And yes, I do want to return the hiking boots. Can the refund go to my credit card as well?

Oh, um, I was really hoping to use my credit card for the pending order changes, not the Visa ending in 3194. Is there really no way to charge the credit card I want to use? 

And about the boots, I guess refunding to PayPal is okay since there's no other option. 

So, to answer your questions:
1. I want to change the luggage and skateboard as you said, but only if I can pay with my credit card. Otherwise, I'm not sure.
2. Yes, please go ahead with the boot return and refund to PayPal.

I guess I'll have to go with the Visa ending in 3194 then. Please go ahead and make the modifications to the luggage and skateboard order with that payment method. 

Thank you for helping me with this.

Thanks for letting me know about the glitch. I guess it's okay for now since the payment and items are correct. I don't want to bother anyone else about it.

No, that's all for now. Thanks for your help. 

###STOP###
